about: Sarah Q. Wirskye attended law school and graduated from Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 1998. Sarah Wirskye began practicing law in 1998.

Sarah Wirskye is an attorney at Bradley Arant Boult Cummings LLP, helping people with Criminal Defense: White Collar issues. Bradley Arant Boult Cummings LLP has an office in Dallas, Texas, serving the local community.

Sarah Wirskye was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
